subject: Discrete Mathematics: Set Theory & Algebra
name: Functions
priorityEvidence: 30 PYQs extracted, tested 1987-2026 continuously including the new GATE DA stream (2026). Builds directly on Relations (a function is a relation with extra constraints).

prerequisites.why: A function is a relation where every domain element maps to exactly one codomain element.
Counting one-one/onto functions directly reuses permutation and inclusion-exclusion counting techniques.

unlocks.why: Group homomorphisms/isomorphisms are structure-preserving functions — needs solid function vocabulary first.
Code-tracing 'identify the function' pattern in Algorithms assumes comfort with function notation and properties.
